Ryan Flournoy (/fləˈnɔɪ/ flə-NOY; born October 27, 1999) is an American professional football wide receiver for the Dallas Cowboys of the National Football League (NFL). Charlotte Woad (born 17 January 2004) is an English professional golfer. She won the 2022 Girls Amateur Championship and 2024 Augusta National Women's Amateur, and reached number one in the World Amateur Golf Ranking in June 2024.
Woad won the KPMG Women's Irish Open on the Ladies European Tour in July 2025 while still an amateur. Later that month, she won her first tournament as a professional – the ISPS Handa Women's Scottish Open. In May 2026, she won her second LPGA Tour title at the Kroger Queen City Championship in Cincinnati. She represented Europe in the 2026 Solheim Cup.
In 2021, Woad won the Welsh Women's Open Stroke Play Championship. In May 2022, she made her debut on the Ladies European Tour in the Madrid Open. In August 2022, Woad won the Girls Amateur Championship.
Woad enrolled at Florida State University in 2022 and started playing with the Florida State Seminoles women's golf team.

The 2028 FIFA Women's Club World Cup will be the inaugural edition of the FIFA Women's Club World Cup, an international women's soccer club competition organized by FIFA, to be hosted by the United States. It is scheduled to be contested by 19 teams from January 5 to 30, 2028.
The tournament was originally scheduled to be played in early 2026 but was delayed by two years.
FIFA initially announced plans to establish a global women's club competition in May 2021. It would be structured similarly to the men's Club World Cup, which was scheduled to become a quadrennial tournament beginning with the 2025 edition. The FIFA Council approved the updated women's soccer calendar at the 74th FIFA Congress held in Bangkok in May 2024, which included the inaugural Women's Club World Cup in early 2026. The first edition of the quadrennial tournament was to be played in January and February 2026 and involve 16 teams.
